video_title: Stephon Castle on Learning From Portland Loss and Adapting for Future Games

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on the Spurs' inconsistent performance against Portland
quotes.excerpt: It was a weird game. It was an up and down game. They were very physical.
quotes.quote: It was a weird game. It was an up and down game. They were very physical. They made a lot of tough shots. We missed a lot of shots that we usually make. We just kept at it, we wanted it, and I feel like we still gave ourselves a chance to contend.
quotes.social_post: Stephon Castle on the loss to Portland: It was a weird game. They were very physical and made a lot of tough shots, but we kept at it and gave ourselves a chance to contend.

structured.context: Stephon Castle discusses the Spurs' performance and the physical nature of their recent game against the Portland Trail Blazers.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified reporter
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on maintaining team confidence despite shooting struggles
quotes.excerpt: There's a lot of positives still in the whole game.
quotes.quote: It's one where the threes aren't falling, and you're still in it. Vic has a great game, and y'all are all, I think there's a lot of positives still in the whole game. That's just what you think, how do you take those to the next?
quotes.social_post: A reporter asks Stephon Castle how the Spurs can build on the positives from a game where the shots were not falling.

structured.context: A reporter asks Stephon Castle how the team plans to build on the positives from their recent game despite shooting struggles.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on the need for better team consistency
quotes.excerpt: Usually it's a lot more clean. That's the reason why we lost.
quotes.quote: Just not completely beating ourselves. Usually it's a lot more clean. That's the reason why we lost. To be specific, tonight it was just the little things. We had some weird plays, shots that kind of hurt in the moment, but I mean, if you really watch the possession, there was a shot that we probably wanted, another shot.
quotes.social_post: Stephon Castle on the Spurs loss: We just need to stop beating ourselves. It was the little things tonight and some weird plays that hurt us in the moment.

structured.context: Stephon Castle explains that the team's loss was primarily due to self-inflicted mistakes and a lack of consistency on small details.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on the defensive challenges of guarding NBA talent
quotes.excerpt: I'm in the NBA. You get talent players in the world.
quotes.quote: I mean, that happens. I'm in the NBA. You get talent players in the world. So, I mean, you get a player to trade three seconds to read the defense, and they get off a contested three, and they still get it to go. That's just how the league is, and you have to get used to that battle against that every single night.
quotes.social_post: Stephon Castle on the reality of NBA defense: You get the best players in the world. Sometimes they hit a contested three and that is just how the league is. You have to get used to that battle every single night.

structured.context: Stephon Castle reflects on the difficulty of defending talented NBA players who can make contested shots.
